title: Queues — where GPUs are stuck
description: E03 slice 1: idle GPUs by accountable stage owner, overdue GPU-hours against stage objectives, longest waits and reasons. Source: TTV ledger (Postgres).

list.name: stage_owner
list.label: Stage owner
list.description: Team that owns the stage an idle GPU waits in. All = no filter (also keeps rows with no owner).
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT stage_owner FROM capacity_intervals WHERE stage_owner IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT stage_owner FROM capacity_intervals WHERE stage_owner IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.description: Site from assets.site; assets with no site appear as '(none)'. All = no site filter.
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(site, '(none)') FROM assets ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(site, '(none)') FROM assets ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Data as of (last successful scan)
panels.description:
Definition: finish time of the most recent scan_runs row with status 'ok', one value per scan kind (e.g. engine, collector).
Units: timestamp in the dashboard timezone (stored UTC).
Filters: none.
Unknown vs zero: a kind that has never finished an 'ok' scan has no value here; partial, failed and dry_run scans never count as success.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT kind,
       (extract(epoch FROM max(finished_at)) * 1000)::bigint AS last_ok
FROM scan_runs
WHERE status = 'ok' AND finished_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY kind
ORDER BY kind

panels.title: Data age
panels.description:
Definition: now minus the finish time of the most recent 'ok' scan, per scan kind.
Units: duration. Colour: green under 20 min, orange from 20 min, red from 60 min; purple = never succeeded (unknown).
Filters: none.
Unknown vs zero: a kind with no successful scan shows no value in purple, never an age of 0.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT kind,
       extract(epoch FROM now() - max(finished_at)) AS age_s
FROM scan_runs
WHERE status = 'ok' AND finished_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY kind
ORDER BY kind

panels.title: Policy version in use
panels.description:
Definition: distinct policy_version of the currently open ledger intervals. Two values mean intervals opened under an earlier policy are still open (an unchanged bucket keeps the policy it was opened under); overdue uses each interval's own policy.
Units: text. Filters: none.
Unknown vs zero: 'no open intervals' means the engine has not written a scan yet, not that no policy applies.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(string_agg(DISTINCT policy_version, ', ' ORDER BY policy_version), 'no open intervals') AS policy_version
FROM capacity_intervals
WHERE ended_at IS NULL

panels.title: Coverage: GPUs UNKNOWN vs total
panels.description:
Definition: of all GPUs in open ledger intervals (every category), how many are UNKNOWN (stale source, identity conflict, cluster not observed, ...). Servers whose GPU count server-scan has not read are listed separately: they have no GPU total, so they are not inside 'GPUs in scope'.
Units: GPUs; share = UNKNOWN GPUs / GPUs in scope.
Filters: site (stage_owner does not apply: UNKNOWN GPUs have no stage owner).
Unknown vs zero: UNKNOWN GPUs are never counted as idle or productive; no value (purple) = no ledger data for this scope. Current state = intervals still open in the ledger (ended_at IS NULL), i.e. the result of the latest engine scan; check 'Data as of' for its age.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'UNKNOWN'), 0) END AS "UNKNOWN GPUs",
       sum(i.gpus) AS "GPUs in scope",
       CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'UNKNOWN'), 0)::float / sum(i.gpus) END AS "UNKNOWN share",
       (SELECT count(*)
          FROM assets a
         WHERE a.gpu_count IS NULL
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals j WHERE j.asset_id = a.asset_id AND j.ended_at IS NULL)
           AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))) AS "Servers, GPU count unread"
FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL
  AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))

panels.title: Idle GPUs now, by stage owner
panels.description:
Definition: sum(gpus) of open IDLE intervals, grouped by stage_owner (the team accountable for the stage the GPUs wait in; a next-action annotation never changes it). Owners seen in the ledger with no idle GPUs now show 0 when the scope has open intervals.
Units: physical GPUs.
Filters: site, stage_owner.
Unknown vs zero: 0 means the latest scan classified no GPU of that owner as idle. UNKNOWN GPUs are not in these bars (see 'UNKNOWN GPUs'); 'No data' means the ledger has no open intervals at all. Current state = intervals still open in the ledger (ended_at IS NULL), i.e. the result of the latest engine scan; check 'Data as of' for its age.

targets.rawSql:
WITH owners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(stage_owner, '(no owner)') AS stage_owner
  FROM capacity_intervals
  WHERE category = 'IDLE'
), cur AS (
  SELECT coalesce(i.stage_owner, '(no owner)') AS stage_owner, sum(i.gpus) AS gpus
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE'
    AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT o.stage_owner, coalesce(c.gpus, 0) AS idle_gpus
FROM owners o
LEFT JOIN cur c ON c.stage_owner = o.stage_owner
WHERE ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR o.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
              WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site)))
ORDER BY idle_gpus DESC, o.stage_owner

panels.title: PRODUCTIVE GPUs
panels.description:
Definition: sum(gpus) of open PRODUCTIVE intervals. Productive per AGENT.md §0.2 (Run:ai workload, serving with genuine requests).
Units: physical GPUs.
Filters: site (stage_owner does not apply: PRODUCTIVE GPUs have no stage owner).
Unknown vs zero: 0 = the latest scan classified no GPU as PRODUCTIVE; no value (purple) = no open intervals for this scope. Current state = intervals still open in the ledger (ended_at IS NULL), i.e. the result of the latest engine scan; check 'Data as of' for its age.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'PRODUCTIVE'), 0) END AS gpus
FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL
  AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))

panels.title: UNKNOWN GPUs
panels.description:
Definition: sum(gpus) of open UNKNOWN intervals. GPUs whose state cannot be determined (stale or failed source, identity conflict, cluster not observed). They are never counted as idle or productive; reasons are on the Evidence dashboard.
Units: physical GPUs.
Filters: site (stage_owner does not apply: UNKNOWN GPUs have no stage owner).
Unknown vs zero: 0 = the latest scan classified no GPU as UNKNOWN; no value (purple) = no open intervals for this scope. Current state = intervals still open in the ledger (ended_at IS NULL), i.e. the result of the latest engine scan; check 'Data as of' for its age.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'UNKNOWN'), 0) END AS gpus
FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL
  AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))

panels.title: NOT_CHARGED GPUs
panels.description:
Definition: sum(gpus) of open NOT_CHARGED intervals. Excluded or out of scope by policy (exclusion list, outside target clusters); approved, not waste.
Units: physical GPUs.
Filters: site (stage_owner does not apply: NOT_CHARGED GPUs have no stage owner).
Unknown vs zero: 0 = the latest scan classified no GPU as NOT_CHARGED; no value (purple) = no open intervals for this scope. Current state = intervals still open in the ledger (ended_at IS NULL), i.e. the result of the latest engine scan; check 'Data as of' for its age.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE coalesce(sum(i.gpus) FILTER (WHERE i.category = 'NOT_CHARGED'), 0) END AS gpus
FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL
  AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))

panels.title: Selected period: idle and overdue GPU-hours
Idle and overdue GPU-hours in the time range, by stage owner
panels.description:
Definition: for every IDLE interval, clipped to the dashboard time range (open intervals end at now()):
- Idle GPU-h = gpus x hours idle in range.
- Overdue GPU-h = gpus x hours in range after stage_entered_at + objective, where objective comes from stage_objectives joined on (stage, policy_version) of the interval. Raw idle and overdue are separate (AGENT.md §17: 8 GPUs idle 3 h = 24 idle GPU-h; with a 1 h objective only 16 are overdue).
Units: GPU-h (GPU-hours).
Filters: site, stage_owner, time range.
Unknown vs zero: 'Stage clock' shows '≥' when some stage started before observation (stage_entered_lower_bound): overdue is then a minimum. Idle time with no objective for its (stage, policy_version) is in 'Idle GPU-h, no objective' and is not counted as 0 overdue. Time before an asset was first observed is unknown and not counted. Owners with 0 had no idle GPU-hours in the range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t0, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz, now()) AS t1
), iv AS (
  SELECT coalesce(i.stage_owner, '(no owner)') AS stage_owner,
         i.gpus,
         i.stage_entered_lower_bound AS lb,
         greatest(i.started_at, w.t0) AS s,
         least(coalesce(i.ended_at, now()), w.t1) AS e,
         CASE WHEN o.objective IS NULL OR i.stage_entered_at IS NULL THEN NULL
              ELSE greatest(i.started_at, i.stage_entered_at + o.objective, w.t0) END AS os
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  LEFT JOIN stage_objectives o ON o.stage = i.stage AND o.policy_version = i.policy_version
  CROSS JOIN w
  WHERE i.category = 'IDLE'
    AND i.started_at < w.t1
    AND coalesce(i.ended_at, now()) > w.t0
    AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
    AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
), owners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(i.stage_owner, '(no owner)') AS stage_owner
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  WHERE i.category = 'IDLE' AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
), agg AS (
  SELECT stage_owner,
         sum(gpus * extract(epoch FROM e - s)) / 3600 AS idle_h,
         sum(gpus * extract(epoch FROM greatest(e - os, interval '0'))) FILTER (WHERE os IS NOT NULL) / 3600 AS overdue_h,
         bool_or(lb) AS any_lb,
         coalesce(sum(gpus * extract(epoch FROM e - s)) FILTER (WHERE os IS NULL), 0) / 3600 AS no_objective_h
  FROM iv
  GROUP BY stage_owner
)
SELECT o.stage_owner AS "Stage owner",
       coalesce(g.idle_h, 0) AS "Idle GPU-h",
       CASE WHEN g.stage_owner IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE g.overdue_h END AS "Overdue GPU-h",
       CASE WHEN g.any_lb THEN '≥ (stage began before observation)' ELSE 'observed' END AS "Stage clock",
       coalesce(g.no_objective_h, 0) AS "Idle GPU-h, no objective"
FROM owners o
LEFT JOIN agg g ON g.stage_owner = o.stage_owner
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM capacity_intervals i JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id CROSS JOIN w
              WHERE i.started_at < w.t1 AND coalesce(i.ended_at, now()) > w.t0 AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site)))
ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST, 2 DESC, 1

panels.title: Longest waits (current idle stage episodes)
panels.description:
Definition: one row per asset and current stage episode with open IDLE intervals; 'Idle GPUs' sums the asset's idle buckets in that stage now, 'Reason' lists their reason codes. 'In stage since' is stage_entered_at; 'Idle GPU-h in stage' sums every IDLE interval of the same episode (same asset, stage and stage_entered_at) from its start to now, not limited to the time range. Sorted by days in stage, longest first; top 50.
Units: GPUs, days, GPU-h. Times in UTC.
Filters: site, stage_owner.
Unknown vs zero: '≥' marks a stage that began before observation (stage_entered_lower_bound), so since, days and GPU-h are minimums. Next-action owner/reason come from the newest unexpired next_action_annotations row and are display only: they never change the stage owner or any total; empty = no annotation, not 'no action needed'. Current state = intervals still open in the ledger (ended_at IS NULL), i.e. the result of the latest engine scan; check 'Data as of' for its age. 'Cluster' is the target cluster once the node is known; 'Held by' names the workload holding idle GPUs (namespace/Kind/name) for the GPU-level rows, empty when nothing holds them.

targets.rawSql:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT i.asset_id, i.stage, i.stage_owner, i.stage_entered_at,
         i.stage_entered_lower_bound AS lb,
         sum(i.gpus) AS gpus,
         string_agg(DISTINCT i.reason_code, ', ') AS reasons,
         string_agg(DISTINCT i.gpu_model, ', ') AS gpu_models,
         string_agg(DISTINCT i.cluster, ', ') AS clusters,
         string_agg(DISTINCT i.holder_ref, ', ') AS holders
  FROM capacity_intervals i
  JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
  WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL AND i.category = 'IDLE'
    AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
    AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
  GROUP BY i.asset_id, i.stage, i.stage_owner, i.stage_entered_at, i.stage_entered_lower_bound
), ep AS (
  SELECT c.asset_id, c.stage, c.stage_entered_at,
         sum(j.gpus * extract(epoch FROM coalesce(j.ended_at, now()) - j.started_at)) / 3600 AS gpu_h
  FROM cur c
  JOIN capacity_intervals j
    ON j.asset_id = c.asset_id
   AND j.category = 'IDLE'
   AND j.stage IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.stage
   AND j.stage_entered_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.stage_entered_at
  GROUP BY c.asset_id, c.stage, c.stage_entered_at
)
SELECT c.asset_id AS "Asset",
       a.name AS "Name",
       a.model AS "Model",
       coalesce(c.gpu_models, a.gpu_model) AS "GPU model",
       c.gpus AS "Idle GPUs",
       c.stage_owner AS "Stage owner",
       c.reasons AS "Reason",
       c.clusters AS "Cluster",
       c.holders AS "Held by",
       coalesce(CASE WHEN c.lb THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END
                || to_char(c.stage_entered_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), 'unknown') AS "In stage since (UTC)",
       coalesce(CASE WHEN c.lb THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END
                || to_char(extract(epoch FROM now() - c.stage_entered_at) / 86400, 'FM999990.0'), 'unknown') AS "Days in stage",
       coalesce(CASE WHEN c.lb THEN '≥ ' ELSE '' END
                || to_char(ep.gpu_h, 'FM9999999990.0'), 'unknown') AS "Idle GPU-h in stage",
       na.next_action_owner AS "Next-action owner",
       na.reason AS "Next-action reason"
FROM cur c
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = c.asset_id
LEFT JOIN ep ON ep.asset_id = c.asset_id
            AND ep.stage IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.stage
            AND ep.stage_entered_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.stage_entered_at
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT n.next_action_owner, n.reason
  FROM next_action_annotations n
  WHERE n.asset_id = c.asset_id AND n.expires_at > now()
  ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
) na ON true
ORDER BY now() - c.stage_entered_at DESC NULLS FIRST, c.gpus DESC, c.asset_id
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Reason breakdown now: GPUs by category and reason
panels.description:
Definition: sum(gpus) and distinct assets of open intervals, grouped by category, reason_code and stage owner. Categories are mutually exclusive per GPU, so GPUs add up to 'GPUs in scope' (with the same filters).
Units: physical GPUs; share = GPUs / all GPUs in the table.
Filters: site, stage_owner (selecting an owner keeps only that owner's IDLE rows; rows with no owner show only under All).
Unknown vs zero: UNKNOWN rows are GPUs we cannot classify, kept visible and never folded into IDLE or PRODUCTIVE. A reason absent from the table has 0 GPUs in the latest scan. Current state = intervals still open in the ledger (ended_at IS NULL), i.e. the result of the latest engine scan; check 'Data as of' for its age.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT i.category AS "Category",
       i.reason_code AS "Reason",
       coalesce(i.stage_owner, '—') AS "Stage owner",
       sum(i.gpus) AS "GPUs",
       count(DISTINCT i.asset_id) AS "Assets",
       sum(i.gpus)::float / sum(sum(i.gpus)) OVER () AS "Share of GPUs"
FROM capacity_intervals i
JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id
WHERE i.ended_at IS NULL
  AND ('__all__' IN ($site) OR coalesce(a.site, '(none)') IN ($site))
  AND ('__all__' IN ($stage_owner) OR i.stage_owner IN ($stage_owner))
GROUP BY i.category, i.reason_code, i.stage_owner
ORDER BY CASE i.category WHEN 'IDLE' THEN 1 WHEN 'UNKNOWN' THEN 2 WHEN 'PRODUCTIVE' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
         sum(i.gpus) DESC, i.reason_code
